# rebask-cloudflare-adapter

> Community MIT Cloudflare Workers adapter for Rebask SSR, RSC, native PPR, durable ISR, public CDN HTML, signed Draft Mode and image optimization.
> Experimental. Exact compatibility: @rebask/core0.2.0, Vite8.3.5, Node24+.

- [Quick start](https://github.com/hipdev/rebask-cloudflare-adapter/blob/main/README.md)
- [Spanish guide](https://github.com/hipdev/rebask-cloudflare-adapter/blob/main/README.es.md)
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/hipdev/rebask-cloudflare-adapter/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Architecture and limits](https://github.com/hipdev/rebask-cloudflare-adapter/blob/main/docs/architecture.md)
- [Testing](https://github.com/hipdev/rebask-cloudflare-adapter/blob/main/docs/testing.md)
- [Source](https://github.com/hipdev/rebask-cloudflare-adapter/tree/main/src)

Configure cloudflarePpr() after native Rebask plugins and createCacheHandler() in
rebask.config.ts. Build once; deploy .output/server/wrangler.json. Never publish
private snapshots as assets. Use cloudflarePpr({ durableCache: true }) for bounded durable cache, native ISR and tag invalidation; default remains immutable. Read architecture before enabling shared runtime data.

- [Platform services and security](docs/platform-features.md)

- Managed Workers Cache is opt-in: pageCache.mode="workers-cache". Pre-execution
  Vary isolates cookies/auth/RSC. revalidateTag awaits native purge after DO barrier.
  Native HITs skip the handler; legacy Cache API HITs still execute it. Purge has
  provider propagation semantics; preserve the stronger legacy mode when required.
